decisions.reason: The necessary cover impact is already completely represented by the existing same-message MODIFY setting trim_size to 6 x 9 inches.
The selected paperback trim size does not change the chapter-heading capitalization, punctuation, or hierarchy requirements.
Selecting a 6 x 9 inch trim size does not alter the requirement to update table-of-contents page numbers after the book size is fixed.
The trim-size selection does not change the existing requirements to preserve image aspect ratios and avoid unintended cropping.

The trim-size decision does not change chapter coverage or placement at the beginning of each chapter; the separate statement about full-page images is only under consideration and is not part of the source Event's established update.
Paperback trim size has no necessary effect on the copyright-page publication attribution line.
The trim-size selection does not change the approved title text or the prohibition on the unintended newline marker.
The 6 x 9 inch trim decision does not alter image-source permissions or the criteria for evaluating illustration suitability.
Choosing the trim size does not change the requested guidance about front matter, back matter, or other publication prerequisites.
The paperback trim-size selection does not change the required back matter or author lines.
The trim-size decision does not alter the authoritative manuscript content, tracked edits, highlighted additions, or table punctuation.
The selected physical trim size does not change the manuscript's copyediting, clarity, or meaning-preservation requirements.
